description: Heated dry Earth at the pilot's tiny resolution (l_max 10, 16x32, 25 levels): construction, RK4 startup vs leapfrog stepping, one simulated day through the production loop with its daily sample and checkpoint, then exact resume from that checkpoint compared bitwise with the uninterrupted run.

capture.method: sys.setprofile: Python call/return events in the scenario thread; selected boundary metadata; device events from visible CuPy calls

code.source_hash_method: tools.architecture.provenance.working_tree: SHA-256 over LF-normalized .py/.cu/.html files (comparable with a snapshot's metrics.json)

configuration.hash_method: RadiativeConfig.sha256() (the run's own configuration identity, also stored in config.json and every checkpoint)

synchronization.note: The production loop synchronizes where production code does: day-boundary finiteness/validation checks (bool of a device reduction, invisible to the collector as a call), the daily sample and checkpoint (host transfers). The verification phase deliberately copies both runs' states to the host. The collector itself adds none.

timing.overhead_protocol: cold uninstrumented run, warm uninstrumented run, traced run, in one process; ratio = traced / warm

semantics.gpu_execution_time: NOT MEASURED; use a synchronized profile or Nsight in a separate run
semantics.units: none inferred; only explicit source contracts are shown by the atlas
semantics.unobserved: a function absent from this capture was not called in THIS scenario; it is not evidence of unused code
semantics.wall_ns_inclusive: host wall time from call to return, including callees, tracing overhead and asynchronous GPU launches; recursive calls count their time at every level

verification.claim: a run resumed from its day-1 checkpoint and advanced 3 steps equals the uninterrupted run advanced 3 steps (time levels, step count, surface temperature, coupling budget)
